'''Somavva''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==History==
This [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was the first to report to the [[Independent Traders' Infonet/Legends|Independent Traders' Infonet]] that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] was boarding free-traders' ships, shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|13|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
